text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen'. Every single rival
is a powerhouse Umamusume. But..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo won't lose when it comes to popularity!
After all, I made it into the top 10!

Yes, Twin Turbo brilliantly
secured a spot in the top 10 of the fan vote.

The appeal of her running has already spread completely.
All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, got a strategy for today?
If you do, I'm all ears.

A grand showdown with powerhouse rivals galore. Clever schemes won't work.
The order is—just one thing.
choice_data_list: Time to give it everything I've got and leave nothing behind!
Time to give it everything I've got and leave nothing behind!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Total combustion! Right, right?
Turbo likes that too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna burn brighter today than I ever have before.
Because...!
Yes, today was the day she had been waiting for all along.

Emerging from a long, long tunnel,
Tokai Teio is finally back on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tokai... Teio...
Umm...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, for the most part.
Though I don't know how far I can run...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —I have no doubts. Because today, from this very spot, I'm going to start a brand-new legend.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...!
You're just so cool after all, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: (She's back...! The Teio that Turbo knows! My eternal rival!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ah, but then again~...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What is it? Uh, if I remember right...
It was Twin Turbo, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
(Kinda feels like Teio
doesn't really pay much mind to Turbo~)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
(She gets names wrong all the time, too...
Well, as long as she's feeling better...)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna lose today.
Umm... Double Jet!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo! See, I knew it~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, just kidding, just kidding.
I remember it properly, of course.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When I was on the verge of giving up...
she was the Umamusume who reminded me
never to throw in the towel...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for you, I never would've
been able to come back here. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "There's no way I'd forget. And today, I—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I want to beat you more than anyone else!
You, who always fearlessly led the pack and kept pulling me forward."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Today, we'll see whose courage is greater, Master Twin Turbo!
It's a showdown!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo... Master?
Whose courage... is greater...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh, Teio! Teio!
Tokai Teiooooo!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose, my rival for life!
On this grandest of stages—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I challenge you, Tokai Teiooooo!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, here I go! I'll chase after you,
and I'll pass you right by!

The revival of a genius. To Twin Turbo, her opponent's
extraordinary talent may still be a massive threat.
Even so...

—The results don't matter.
Run the only way Twin Turbo can, burn bright to the very end, and get the fans on their feet.
